R_NORMAL: Standard 12-hour clock convention: PM toggles at the 11:59:59<->12:00:00 boundary and hours wrap 12->01 after 12:59:59.
PM could toggle at the 12:59:59->01:00:00 boundary instead of at 12:00:00 under an unusual convention.
Hour rollover could be 12->01 immediately at 12:00:00 rather than after 12:59:59 under an unusual convention.
Hour wraps 12->01 immediately on the first increment after reset 12:00:00, instead of after 12:59:59.
